payload.friendly_name: Module-local test gaps and promise-first scenario verdicts
payload.purpose_context: The 2026-11-03 test suite assessment found that each module's own tests reach less than the aggregate coverage suggests (W1, W2, R4, #370): kernel.validation has 58 % branch coverage, profiles a 53 % mutation score with 29 untouched mutants, and packs.infra.fetch's CappedBodySubscriber no test of its own. It also found 27 promise-first scenarios that predate the Cucumber harness and run under no runner (R8, #374). This mission closes the module gaps with tests proved by planted breaks and gives each of the 27 scenarios a recorded map, wire or retire verdict.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give kernel validation, profiles and the guide fetcher's body cap tests of their own, and decide what happens to 27 scenarios no test runner executes.

payload.question: ADR-0005 registration/distribution cluster (15 scenarios): retire as planned-later, or product gap?
REFUSAL-001 (enhances merge that drops profile fields is refused): product gap handling?
SHARING-003 (reserved skill namespaces refused): service-owned product gap or core-owned retire?

payload.final_answer: Move the 15 ADR-0005/0019 scenarios under contracts/charter/scenarios/<cluster>/ tagged @WIP (not run, copy rule unchanged); README says not built, by decision; no issue
Product gap: file a follow-up issue (enhances merge that drops fields is refused; ADR-0032/ADR-0053 d22) and add a @WIP contract placeholder pointing to it
Service-owned product gap: file a follow-up issue (refuse reserved skill namespaces in org-charter skill_namespace; schema pattern re-imported per ADR-0017 plus one @contract scenario)
